title: On the Statistical Mechanics of Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.17347v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We revisit the statistical mechanics of Transformer attention via modern Hopfield models. We present a free-energy formalism to characterize parameter regimes and critical thresholds for robust attention inference. The resulting free-energy landscape incorporates randomness in query states and attention weights. Attention then emerges as the equation of motion of the corresponding statistical-mechanical system (i.e., modern Hopfield model) through the standard free-energy minimization principle. This allows us to identify first-order phase transitions in attention between glassy and robust-inference phases. We further extend to attentions with stochastic queries and keys. Together, our results provide a rigorous statistical-mechanics framework for characterizing phase structure and inference reliability across a family of Transformer attention mechanisms.

translated_abstract: 我们借助现代Hopfield模型重新审视Transformer注意力的统计力学。我们提出了一个自由能形式化方法，用以刻画稳健注意力推理的参数区域和临界阈值。所得的自由能景观包含了查询状态和注意力权重中的随机性。通过标准的最小自由能原理，注意力作为相应统计力学系统（即现代Hopfield模型）的运动方程而自然涌现。这使我们能够识别注意力在玻璃态与稳健推理相之间的一阶相变。我们进一步将该方法扩展到具有随机查询和键的注意力机制。总体而言，我们的结果为表征一系列Transformer注意力机制的相结构和推理可靠性提供了一个严格的统计力学框架。
tldr: 本文借助现代Hopfield模型的自由能形式化方法，建立了刻画Transformer注意力相结构与推理可靠性的严格统计力学框架，并揭示出注意力在玻璃态与稳健推理相之间存在一阶相变。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a rigorous statistical-mechanics framework for Transformer attention via free-energy formalism of modern Hopfield models, revealing first-order phase transitions between glassy and robust-inference phases.
